messages.subject: AniMove 2023 in Canada
parts:
We are very happy to host this year’s AniMove summer school at the University of British Columbia / Okanagan Campus in beautiful Kelowna, Canada, from August 7 to 18, 2023.

If you think others could benefit from this two-week intensive training course, please spread the word to your fellow colleagues, friends and collaborators that applications will be excepted until the 15th February 2023.

To apply please go to our website https://animove.org/canada-2023/
